TABLE.NAME: block_qcexp_carried
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per student whose grade or completion this plugin carried from an original quiz onto its copy, and then protected with an override. The row is deleted once the student beats that grade with an attempt of their own, which is when the override is released.

FIELD.NAME: quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: Quiz instance id of the copy. Foreign key references quiz.id.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module id of the copy. Foreign key references course_modules.id.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student the work was carried over for. Foreign key references user.id.

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: The carried-over grade being defended, on the copy's own grade scale. Null when only completion was carried over, and there is no grade to defend.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the work was carried over.

INDEX.NAME: quizid-userid
INDEX.COMMENT: The lookup every submitted quiz attempt on the site makes.
